summary: Approved the explicitly renewed bounded pending-start shutdown/cancellation contract on the frozen offline source snapshot. Strengthened retention-before-release and explicit-reap-after-termination assertions are legitimate and pass; no new or remaining in-scope security or logic defect found.

approval_boundary.whole_project_combined_gate: Parent-owned and not substituted by this scoped review.

review_findings: agent_runtime.disconnect selects timeout=0 only for pending producer startup; successfully online shutdown retains the original argument-free unbounded join. No unsafe thread injection, polling shutdown or automatic reconnect/reap is introduced.

An unsuccessful join retains the thread, pending ownership and client; is_alive=False or ident=None is not accepted instead of a successful join. Host.stop attempts the other agents and WorldFeed, and withholds all journals while any startup ownership remains pending.

Actual playing.run_host attempts shutdown on any BaseException, adds only a cleanup exception-class diagnostic, and bare-raises the exact original object with deepest originating frame intact. Normal-completion shutdown errors still propagate; CLI KeyboardInterrupt policy remains unchanged.

The repository producer helper now requires an explicit Event release instead of two-second automatic expiry. Its legacy run_host case asserts exact SystemExit/frame, live retained worker, pending flags, no client/journal close, failed repeated stop without release, then explicit release/join/reap and client-before-journal termination-safe closure. This is a stronger two-phase oracle, not relaxed acceptance. Endpoint/privacy assertions remain present.

The obsolete scratch immediate-close assertion is not the renewed contract oracle. Its original file, previous failing JUnit and implementation report remain byte-for-byte preserved. A separately named current-contract copy replaces timed expiry with explicit release and verifies both retention and reap; every case in that copy ran without skips.

Nine new independent Event-controlled lifecycle cases exercise the real host and run_host, RuntimeError/SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt, direct disconnect/host.stop/run_host, repeated denied reconnect and repeated bounded stop, later participant cleanup, all-journal retention, and explicit reap. They observe return before release, not timer-driven eventual success.
